verdicts.reason: Both are the same competent banner reflow (striped image panel left, lime copy panel right): the 48H ONLY badge is jammed against the Voltstride box, the subcopy is tiny at 728x90 and the CTA floats with empty lime space below it. A wins narrowly because its subcopy roughly shares the headline's left edge and its smaller badge crowds the box less. In B the badge is oversized and nearly collides with the box, and the subcopy starts left of the headline, so the edges are ragged.
